उद्द्राव a. Running away.
--वः
Flight, retreat.
उद्रः A kind of aquatic animal.

उद्रिन् a. Springing; abounding in
water.

उद्रंकः, --गः N. of the town of
हरिश्चंद्र.

उद्रंकः, --गः N. of the town of
हरिश्चंद्र.

उद्रथः [उद्गतो रथो यस्मात्]
1 The
pin of the axle of a carriage.
--2 A
cock.

उद्रिच् (chiefly used in pass.)
1 To excel, surpass (with abl.);
ममैवोद्रिच्यते जन्म-तव जन्मनः Mb.
--2 To increase, exceed,
preponderate.
--3 To abound in.

उद्रिक्त p. p.
1 Increased,
excessive, abundant.
--2 Distinct,
evident.

;
गत्वोद्रेकं जघनपुलिने Śi. 7. 74; so
मोह˚, धन˚, मद˚.
--2 Commencement,
outset.
--का The plant (महानिंब).
--Comp.
--भंगः discouraging a
thing at the very beginning.

उद्रुज a.
1 Destroying, breaking
down.
--2 Undermining (as a bank);
as in कूलमुद्रुज q. v.
